a01.title: See the people behind the performance.
a01.description: EMPULSE connects performance, wellbeing and innovation into one living picture — so you can protect people from burnout, grow talent and measure the value of every decision.
a01.welcome_desc: Sign in to your organization's EMPULSE workspace.

a01.trust_text: EMPULSE never reads message content, keystrokes or screens. Insights come from work outcomes, workload signals and voluntary check-ins — and every AI recommendation is reviewed by a person.
